messages.subject: Project Mosaic - SPA limitations and warranty package
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Our first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement is in the data room. To frame the warranty negotiation, our opening positions on the key levers are:

- Warrantor liability cap: 100% of the Investment Amount.
- Claims survival / time limit: 18 months from Completion.
- IP warranties: given without an awareness qualifier.
- Founder non-compete and non-solicitation: 24 months.
- De minimis: 15% of the Threshold; Threshold GBP 60,000.
- Conditions: a Material Adverse Change condition at clause 3.1.7, unqualified.

We've kept the rest close to market. Look forward to your mark-up.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: James, Our mark-up is back in the data room. The warranty package is too heavy for a round this size
messages.subject: RE: Project Mosaic - SPA limitations and warranty package
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up is back in the data room. The warranty package is too heavy for a round this size; our positions are:

- Liability cap: 50% of the Investment Amount. A 100% cap on a GBP 4m round effectively puts the founder's entire consideration at risk.
- Survival: 12 months. One audit cycle is the right period for a company at this stage.
- IP warranties: must be qualified by the founder's awareness - "so far as the Founder is aware". Sophie cannot give flat IP warranties given the volume of open-source dependencies.
- Non-compete and non-solicitation: 12 months.
- De minimis 20% of the Threshold; Threshold GBP 100,000.
- The MAC condition should be softened or dropped - it gives the investor a walk-away on ordinary trading volatility.

Happy to talk these through.

Regards,
Adam

Adam Selby | Partner | Denham Lewis LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Mosaic - SPA limitations and warranty package
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Having taken our client's instructions, here is where we settle as a package:

- Liability cap: 75% of the Investment Amount. We won't go to 50%.
- Survival: 12 months from Completion. Agreed - we'll meet you here given the size of the round.
- IP warranties: agreed to qualify by the founder's awareness - "so far as the Founder is aware" - with the usual deemed-knowledge wording (actual knowledge plus due and careful enquiry of senior management).
- Non-compete and non-solicitation: 18 months. 12 is too short for the goodwill our client is paying for; 24 was our opener; 18 is the landing.
- De minimis: 20% of the Threshold, agreed; Threshold GBP 80,000 (between our 60 and your 100).
- MAC condition at 3.1.7: retained. We've kept it tied to a material adverse effect on the business, so ordinary volatility won't trip it, but the condition stays.

If that works we'll move to execution versions.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
